digest.component_or_area: config root derivation in composer and edit paths
propositions: Three advisory config reads (description_cap_warning, duplicate_create_warning, _edit_description_warning) incorrectly derive cfg_root from dirname(str(tracker)) instead of repo_root, causing suppressed warnings on relocated stores with no rebar.toml in the store's parent directory.

On a relocated store (REBAR_TRACKER_DIR environment variable), dirname(str(tracker)) points to the store parent rather than the code repository root, causing compose_config() to read empty/default configuration values.

The existing AC#4 guard (check_repo_root_from_tracker.py) only catches bare dirname(tracker) and dirname(tracker_dir()) forms but does not detect the str()-wrapped variant dirname(str(tracker)), leaving three advisory sites unprotected.

The str()-variant advisory sites must resolve cfg_root from repo_root (already in scope in create_core and edit_core) to match the relocatable-store contract, requiring thread of repo_root parameter into _edit_description_warning().
The realpath() and abspath() family of config-root derivations (reads.py:238/249/374 and compact_*/fsck_* sites) require separate per-site design judgment and are deferred to a follow-up ticket.
